column3: Close to the Hebrew; כֶּלִי (“a vessel”) is rendered “jewelry.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your evil report will not turn back” is rendered “your reputation be ruined.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the verse, beginning with “A word fitly spoken.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the cold of snow on a day of harvest” is rendered “in time of harvest,” and “restores” “refreshes.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the verse and renders “a gift of falsehood” as “falsely boasts of giving.”
Close to the Hebrew; “length of anger” is rendered “long forbearance.”
Close to the Hebrew; שֵׁן רֹעָה (“a broken tooth”) is rendered “a bad tooth.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַתָּה חֹתֶה (“heap up”) is rendered “you will heap.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a tongue of secrecy” is rendered “a backbiting tongue.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַעְיָן נִרְפָּשׂ (“a trampled spring”) is rendered “a murky spring.”
The second line is difficult (“the searching of their glory is glory”); NKJV supplies a negative, “to seek one’s own glory is not glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the verse, beginning with “Whoever has no rule over his own spirit.”
